description: Test information is not appropriately selected, protected, and managed. This signal indicates that test data, including production data used in testing, is not properly sanitized, masked, anonymized, or protected, potentially exposing sensitive or personal information in non-production environments.
applicability: Applicable to all testing activities using data including development testing, QA testing, UAT, performance testing, security testing, and training environments. Covers test databases, test files, test datasets, synthetic data generation, and production data copies used for testing purposes.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of test data policies, data masking procedures, test data provisioning processes, access controls on test environments, and analysis of data flows from production to test systems. May also be identified through privacy impact assessments and data classification reviews.
